title: [YouPass Collect] - Postgraduate Subject Fees in US dollars (2007)
prompt: The table below shows the annual costs for students to study in masters programmes in three different countries in 2007.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The table compares postgraduate tuition fees and accommodation costs, measured in US dollars, in three countries in 2007.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, Country A offered the most affordable education across all disciplines, while Country B charged the highest fees for technical subjects, namely computing and science. Notably, Country C maintained identical tuition costs for three out of the four academic programmes.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding STEM-related fields, computing and science courses in Country A both cost $18,000, which was considerably lower than in the other two nations. Country B had the most expensive fees for these subjects, at $27,254 and $28,675 respectively, approximately 50% higher than Country A. Meanwhile, Country C charged slightly less than Country B, with computing costing $21,783 and science standing at $24,569.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining categories, arts and business programmes in Country A were priced at $12,000 and $14,000, in that order. These figures rose to $17,200 and $15,698 in Country B, while Country C recorded the highest tuition for both subjects at an identical rate of $21,783. In terms of accommodation with meals, Country A offered the lowest cost at $8,000, which was approximately $3,000 less than Country B's figure of $11,256. Country C, on the other hand, required students to pay the most for living expenses, at $17,345, more than double that of Country A.
